input.determinism_note: The official generator creates phase/noise tensors with torch.rand/torch.randn_like. Seed eager and export screens where the runtime exposes control. The pinned ONNX contains unseeded RandomUniformLike and RandomNormalLike nodes, so Android ONNX repetitions are not expected to be bit-identical; retain every hash and report this limitation rather than treating output variance as representation error.

matched_android_contract.route_order_caveat: Fixed rather than randomized. Record battery temperature before and after each route and allow at least 120 seconds idle between successful route campaigns when both are eligible.
matched_android_contract.timed_scope: UTF-8 text through lexicon/G2P tokenization, official voice-row selection, speed input, complete neural inference, and in-memory float audio assembly. Model/session construction and WAV encoding are reported separately.
matched_android_contract.wav_selection: first successful generation from each eligible route

frontend.policy: Both routes must execute the same deterministic production-derived frontend from text, not consume a neural intermediate fixture.
frontend.english_lexicon: pinned sherpa Kokoro v1.0 US-English lexicon generated from pinned Misaki dictionaries
frontend.fallback: eSpeak fallback is allowed only if packaged and executed on device; the selected transcript must instead be proven fully covered by the pinned lexicon.
frontend.token_ids: resolved at runtime from pinned tokens.txt
frontend.voice_style: select af_heart[len(unpadded_token_ids)] from a lossless float32 serialization of the exact official af_heart.pt tensor

host_fidelity_gate.reference: official PyTorch KModel from the pinned FP32 checkpoint, evaluated with exact runtime tokens, style row, speed, and reference seed where controllable
host_fidelity_gate.unmatched_rng_policy: When a runtime does not expose reproducible random inputs, waveform metrics are descriptive only and cannot pass the numerical fidelity gate. Weight identity, architecture/export provenance, duration/output shape, validity, repeated-run variation, and listening evidence remain separate.
host_fidelity_gate.note: Thresholds are prospective acceptance gates, not proof that operator-wise arithmetic is identical.

provider_gate.onnxruntime: CPUExecutionProvider only; no QNN provider library, option, profile event, or provider event
provider_gate.executorch: XNNPACK or portable CPU kernels only; no Qualcomm/QNN backend or delegate

memory.primary: VmHWM from /proc/self/status after each phase in a fresh route process
memory.limitations: Process-lifetime RSS high-water includes runtime, model mapping, transient allocations, Java/JNI state, and prior phases in that process. It is neither steady live PSS nor component-isolated memory.

stop_conditions: Do not repair torch.export failures with broad model surgery or custom kernels.
Do not run an ExecuTorch phone route unless exact-source host export and fidelity gates pass.
Do not enable HTP, QNN, NNAPI, GPU, Vulkan, or quantization.
Do not reinterpret a failed route as a successful runtime comparison. Preserve its exact bounded blocker.
